text:
alex: Heads-up — planning a slow-bloom rollout for runtime v1.12.3. Goal: minimize risk for the new attention kernel. Steps: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%. Window: 2026-02-19 22:00-00:00 UTC. maria will execute. jordan oncall for SLOs. Need quick preflight checklist and rollback plan.

maria: ack, I'll own the deploy. Doing a staging smoke at 20:00 UTC, then prod preflight ~21:30. I'll use the slow-bloom strategy and follow the step waits. tagging infra: @sanchit please pause autoscaler and pin reserved GPUs for the first 30m.

sanchit: noted — I'll pause autoscaler and set reserved-pool=true for the first two steps. routing policy will be: new-variant -> traffic-split by percentage. Also recommend KV cache warmup=off for 1% to reduce noise.

jordan: I'll watch latency and error-rate dashboards. Focus: p50/p95/p99 and 5xx rate. Callout: if p99 > 600ms or 5xx spike > 0.5% for 3 consecutive mins at any step, we roll back.

alex: rollout command (local runbook snippet):
```
# run from deployer host
./deploy --env=prod \
  --version=v1.12.3 \
  --strategy=slow-bloom \
  --steps=1,5,20,50,100 \
  --step-wait=600  # seconds to observe at each step
```

maria: preflight smoke checklist (quick):
- staging smoke green (health + gen sample)
- infra pins applied
- dashboard alert scopes up
- rollback tested on staging

maria: staging smoke command examples:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"summarize: redwood"}' | jq '.status'  # expect "ok"
# basic latency check
curl -s -w "%{time_total}\n" -o /dev/null https://staging.api.redwood.ai/health | awk '{print $1 < 0.2 ? "ok" : "slow"}'
```

samir: cohort selection suggestion — start with a geographically mixed micro-sample: 1% from US-east, 0.5% from EU-west, 0.5% from AP-south (label it "sunrise-sample"). That helps detect region-specific regressions early.

maria: sounds good. I'll create routing group "sunrise-sample" and verify traffic assignment before step 1.

alex: rollback procedure (short):
- stop rollout
- run: `./deploy rollback --env=prod --to-version=v1.12.2`
- unpin routing (switch traffic back to stable)
- unpause autoscaler after rollback confirmed

jordan: monitoring checklist for each step:
- confirm no cpu/gpu saturations on serving hosts
- tail 5xx logs for new trace IDs
- compare sample responses for quality regression (use saved prompt set)
If any check fails, ping #eng-oncall and mark rollback.

maria: I'll post step updates in this thread with deploy-bot pings. Plan: start at 22:00 UTC, step 1 -> wait 10m, if green proceed to 5% and notify @jordan. I'll also attach quick diffs of sample outputs at each step.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by maria for 2026-02-19T22:00Z. Tracking id: DB-492345. Will post automated step completions and health checks.

alex: one last ask — please verify circuit-breaker and fallback routing are enabled (should fall back to v1.12.2 automatically). If anyone needs a dry-run, ping maria before 21:30. :thumbsup:

maria: got it. I'll run a dry-run at 21:40 and post results.

jordan: available for the window, will have pager open. :white_check_mark:

sanchit: autoscaler pause and pool pin applied in staging and prod preflight. I'll unpin after 50% if things look stable.

alex: thanks team — we'll escalate if anything odd. I'll leave this thread pinned for the window.
